nodes.summary: A group $G$ is flexibly permutation stable when every almost-homomorphism $(f_n)$ from $G$ to the symmetric groups is flexibly close to homomorphisms.
nodes.title: Flexible permutation stability

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group and, for each natural number $n$, let $f_n \colon G \to S_n$ be an arbitrary map, where $S_n$ is the group of permutations of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$. The sequence $(f_n)$ is an almost-homomorphism when for all $g, h \in G$ the normalized Hamming distance $d_n(f_n(g) f_n(h), f_n(gh))$ tends to $0$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Almost-homomorphisms to symmetric groups

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group and let $f_n \colon G \to S_n$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) be maps into the symmetric groups $S_n$ of permutations of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$. The sequence $(f_n)$ is close to homomorphisms when there are group homomorphisms $\rho_n \colon G \to S_n$ such that for every $g \in G$ the normalized Hamming distance $d_n(\rho_n(g), f_n(g))$ tends to $0$ as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Closeness to homomorphisms

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group and let $f_n \colon G \to S_n$ ($n \in \mathbb{N}$) be maps into the symmetric groups $S_n$ of permutations of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$. nodes.title: Flexible closeness to homomorphisms

nodes.summary: Let $G$ be a group and let $G' = [G, G]$ be its commutator subgroup. Then $G$ is metabelian when its second derived subgroup $G'' = [G', G']$ is trivial.
nodes.title: Metabelian groups

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$ and permutations $\sigma$, $\tau$ of $\{0, \dots, n-1\}$, the normalized Hamming distance $d_n(\sigma, \tau)$ is the number of points $i < n$ with $\sigma(i) \ne \tau(i)$, divided by $n$, as a real number. For $n = 0$ it is $0$; this single value does not affect statements about limits as $n \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Normalized Hamming distance

nodes.summary: A group $G$ is permutation stable when every almost-homomorphism $(f_n)$ from $G$ to the symmetric groups $S_n$ is close to homomorphisms.

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
